verse.text: We will not hide these truths from our children; we will tell the next generation about the glorious deeds of the LORD, about his power and his mighty wonders.

video.title: Passing Down Faith | 2 Timothy 1:5 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Every dad is already teaching his kids a story about God — either through the truths you speak or the silence you leave. Psalm 78:4 is a call to be intentional: tell your kids what God has done in your life, not just what you expect from theirs. A five-minute story at dinner about God's faithfulness can outlast a hundred lectures.
